entities.name: Curse of the Werefox
entities.description: A folktale from Eldraine about the elves of Redtooth Keep, based on Beauty and the Beast.

entities.name: Redtooth Keep
entities.description: An elven citadel in Eldraine whose garrison was cursed.

entities.name: Elves of Redtooth Keep
entities.description: Garrison elves who are rangers by day and feral werefoxes by night.

entities.name: Witch
entities.description: A traveler turned away who cursed the elves.

entities.name: Syr Armont
entities.description: A knight who stumbled upon Redtooth Keep and broke the curse.

entities.name: Yenna
entities.description: Leader of the werefoxes who told Armont of the enchanted rose.

entities.name: Wild Rose
entities.description: A mystical rose that blooms in moonlight, guarded by an archon, able to break the curse.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that happened long after the folktale's events.

entities.name: Ardenvale knight
entities.description: A knight who fell in love with and betrothed a werefox.

events.summary: The Redtooth Keep garrison turns away travelers; one is revealed as a witch and curses the elves to transform to match their selfish, bestial hearts.
events.quote: cursed the elves, declaring that their bodies would forever transform to match their hearts' selfish and bestial natures

events.summary: Syr Armont stumbles upon Redtooth Keep and commits herself to breaking the curse.
events.quote: After Syr Armont stumbled upon Redtooth Keep, she committed herself to solving this mystery and breaking the curse.

events.summary: Yenna warms to Armont and tells her of the enchanted rose.
events.quote: Yenna , leader of the werefoxes, warmed up to Armont's kindness and told her of the enchanted rose.

events.summary: Armont and Yenna venture to the glade and Armont breaks the curse; it is implied the two fell in love.
events.quote: the knight was able to break the curse

relations.quote: It is implied the two fell in love.
was revealed to be a powerful witch and cursed the elves
